changes: Added /*@int*/ to all number input procedures just so MCreator knows how to handle it during code-gen
Changed a procedure text "Color [x] to number (Built-in)" to "Color [x] to number (2025.2-)"
(5.5.0) The RGB to int procedure no longer supplies a manual alpha of 255 (even if I was the one to put it there in the first place)
(5.5.0) Changed the ARGB to int procedure text to "Convert Alpha: [a] R: [r] G: [g] B: [b]" just because it fits the order in which the numbers appear in the actual code
(5.5.0) Both RGB and ARGB to int procedures will clamp the color values from 0 to 255
(5.5.0) Number-clamping for certain procedure code for generators 1.20.4 and lower now use Mth.clamp instead of a manual Math.min + Math.max (functionally the same; just more readable)
(5.5.0) Added procedure: "Lerp color [x] to color [y] by scale [z]" in Utils (I took this idea from Spidrone sorrynotsorry)
(5.5.0) Updated procedure code of "Get font ID of [component]" for 26.1.2 to prevent potential crashes
